newsitem.title: FRANCE: Satanist suspect held French priest's murder.
newsitem.headline: Satanist suspect held French priest's murder.

text.p: A Frenchman suspected of belonging to a satanic cult was charged with murder and remanded in custody on Wednesday on suspicion of stabbing to death an elderly priest, the public prosecutor in this eastern city said.
Car factory worker David Obertorf, 18, was alleged to have stabbed 68-year-old Father Jean Uhl 33 times in his church in the Alsatian village of Kingersheim on December 20.
A suspected accomplice, Stephane Fest, 19, was charged with being an accessory to murder and remanded in custody.
"The priest's body bore very specific wounds which suggested satanic symbols," a police spokesman said.
